description: This file defines the TextUtils class within the Goteo project, implementing various text manipulation utilities and registering functions for use in templates or other contexts. The class provides methods for formatting percentages, sanitizing text, converting colors, and wrapping external library calls.

classes.name: TextUtils
classes.description: Provides utility functions for text processing, formatting, and integration with external libraries within the Goteo project.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup method, currently empty placeholder.

methods.name: provideFilters
methods.description: Returns an empty array, meant to provide template filters.

methods.name: provideFunctions
methods.description: Returns an array of functions registered for templates, such as 't', 'text', 'text_html', etc.

methods.name: percent_span
methods.description: Returns an HTML span element with a background color based on a percentage value.

methods.name: percent_badge
methods.description: Creates a badge styled span element representing a percentage.

methods.name: plain
methods.description: Calls Goteo\Library\Text::plain for plain text conversion.

methods.name: markdown
methods.description: Converts markdown text to HTML using the markdown parser service.

methods.name: image_src
methods.description: Generates an image source URL using the Image class.

methods.name: to_rgba
methods.description: Converts a HEX color to RGBA format with specified opacity.
